title: GitCat community plugin index entry
description: One file under community/<id>.json — a POINTER to a plugin that lives in its own repository, not a copy of its manifest. See CONTRIBUTING.md for how to submit one.

id.description: Same charset GitCat itself requires for a plugin id. Must match the `id` inside the plugin's own plugin.json, and must be unique across this whole index (official/ and community/ combined).

name.description: Human-readable display name, matching the plugin's own manifest `name`.

description.description: One-line summary for the index listing.

author.description: The plugin author's name or GitHub handle — whoever maintains the linked repo, not necessarily whoever opened the submission PR.

repo.description: The plugin's own GitHub repository (root URL, no trailing path) — this index never hosts a community plugin's code.

manifestPath.description: Path to plugin.json WITHIN the repo above, e.g. "plugin.json" or "plugins/my-plugin/plugin.json". No leading slash, no "..".

homepage.description: Optional: a docs/homepage URL if different from the repo itself.

minGitcatVersion.description: Optional — mirrors the plugin manifest's own minGitcatVersion, shown in the index listing as a heads-up before someone tries to install it.
